theme: Ansiedade: Mitos vs. Verdades + pensamento positivo tóxico
safe_zone: Keep all main text and logos above the bottom 20% of the frame (TikTok/IG overlays).

visual_dna.palette: Accent magenta/rose pink, deep black, off-white/cream, warm gray paper texture; optional soft yellow highlight sparingly.
visual_dna.style: Contemporary therapy aesthetic: textured paper, subtle collage, small stars or polaroid-style accents, not cold clinical. Portuguese Brazil typography, bold headlines, readable sans-serif.
visual_dna.brand_lockup: Small corner treatment: @stephaniefalanque + line 'PSICÓLOGA DE JOVENS ADULTAS' — place in top or upper-side margin, never in bottom 20%.

slides.on_slide_sub: 3 coisas que talvez já tenham te dito — e o que a ciência mostra
slides.image_prompt: Instagram carousel slide 1, 9:16 vertical. Warm editorial mental-health graphic design. Background: off-white with subtle gray paper grain and soft magenta/pink accent shapes (not neon). Large bold headline in Portuguese: 'Ansiedade: mitos vs. verdades'. Subline smaller: '3 coisas que talvez já tenham te dito'. Decorative: tiny stars, torn-paper edge feel. Corner: small text '@stephaniefalanque' and 'PSICÓLOGA DE JOVENS ADULTAS' in top margin only. No text in bottom 20%. Cohesive, feminine-young-adult friendly, not childish.

slides.on_slide_truth: É uma resposta química e biológica do corpo — não é ' drama '.
slides.image_prompt: Same visual DNA as slide 1: magenta accent, black text on cream paper texture, 9:16. Layout: left 'MITO' in small caps, quote in large quotes; divider; 'VERDADE' label; short explanatory line in Portuguese about chemical/biological stress response. Stars or soft collage scrap. Brand corner top only. No bottom-20% text.

slides.on_slide_truth: Dá para aprender a gerenciar e viver bem — sem promessa mágica de ' sumir pra sempre '.
slides.image_prompt: Match slides 1-2. Portuguese text. Contrast myth vs truth about 'cure' vs management. Slightly stronger visual tension (darker gray shape behind myth, lighter behind truth). Same palette and corner branding. 9:16, no text in bottom 20%.

slides.on_slide_body: Forçar 'fica bem' / 'só pensa positivo' pode piorar a ansiedade.
slides.on_slide_sub: Invalida o que você sente e aumenta a culpa — o corpo continua em alerta.
slides.image_prompt: Same series. Headline 'Pensamento positivo tóxico' in black. Supporting lines in Portuguese about forced positivity worsening anxiety and guilt. Visual: subtle warning accent (muted coral or yellow sticker-style dot, not alarming). Paper collage. Top-only handle. 9:16.

on_slide_bullets: Reduzir a luta contra a ansiedade
Pequenos passos + apoio profissional quando fizer sentido
slides.image_prompt: Educational slide, same brand look. Headline 'O que costuma ajudar mais'. Three short bullet lines in Portuguese (validation, defusion from struggle, small steps/pro support). Calm magenta highlights on bullets. Warm, hopeful but realistic tone. Corner branding top. 9:16, safe zone respected.

slides.on_slide_sub: Me conta nos comentários — vamos desmontar juntas.
slides.image_prompt: Closing slide, inviting. Big question in Portuguese: 'Qual mito você já ouviu?'. Subline: 'Me conta nos comentários'. Small 'Salva pra revisitar' above safe zone (not in bottom 20%). Same visual DNA, slightly more open space, soft star accents. @stephaniefalanque top corner. 9:16.
